titleText: JTF News: UN News, Deutsche Welle
mainText: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached a record number in the first month of an outbreak.
The United States and Iran disagree over whether Tehran has agreed to nuclear inspections.
France experienced its highest recorded temperature on record.
The U.S. Supreme Court ruled that a Rastafarian man cannot sue prison guards who cut his dreadlocks.
